args.text: CREATE TABLE DG (d LONG CONSTRAINT PK_DG PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE NUM (n LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NUM PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO NUM (n) SELECT a.d * 256 + b.d * 16 + c.d + 1 FROM DG AS a, DG AS b, DG AS c ORDER BY a.d, b.d, c.d
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM NUM
CREATE TABLE FO (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FO PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FOI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FOI PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FOV (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FOV PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FL (id COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_FL PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FL (g, d) SELECT 1, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FL (g, d) SELECT 2, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FL (g, d) SELECT 3, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE FLI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FLI PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FLI (id, g, d) SELECT id, g, d FROM FL ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE FG (id COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_FG PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FG (g, d) SELECT n, 9007199254740992 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FG (g, d) SELECT n, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FG (g, d) SELECT n, -9007199254740992 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE FGI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FGI PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FGI (id, g, d) SELECT id, g, d FROM FG ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE FN (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FN PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FS (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FS PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, s SINGLE)
CREATE TABLE FC (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FC PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, c CURRENCY)
CREATE TABLE FD (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FD PRIMARY KEY, g LONG)
SELECT g, Count(*) AS n, Min(id) AS lo, Max(id) AS hi FROM FL GROUP BY g
SELECT g, Count(*) AS n FROM FLI GROUP BY g
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM FG
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM FGI
SELECT id, k, d FROM FO ORDER BY id
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM FN
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM FS
SELECT id, g, x FROM FD
